Plot inspection dates

The committee walks the site three times a year and looks at every plot. The inspection dates for this year are the second Sunday of April, of July and of October. A plot that is not being worked gets a letter, and the holder has four weeks to put it right before the next inspection.

Marsh Lane Allotments, 4 Marsh Lane. Open from dawn to dusk.
